what_it_does: Persistent Systems sells software product engineering services, digital engineering, and enterprise modernization solutions (including AI and cloud transformations) to global enterprises, generating revenue through IT services, platform-led engagements, and software co-development.
other_facts: Total built-up capacity owned in India and abroad was 139,580 m2 adequate for 15,000+ employees.
